versions.changelog: Docs update: Replaced example email addresses with placeholders in SKILL.md
Security update: Removed all default email addresses, now requires environment variables. Added validation check for required env vars.
Security fix: Removed hardcoded email credentials, now uses environment variables. Added .env.example template and .gitignore.

Initial release of crypto-price-pro:

- Query real-time and historical prices for 10+ major cryptocurrencies.
- Generate single or multi-coin trend/comparison charts.
- Automated 7-day weekly report creation.
- Scheduled email report delivery supported.
- Easy setup instructions and usage examples included.
